end.summary:
Discussed family members’ ways of caring for one another.
Identified cooking, cleaning, getting ready, and making favourite food as household care.
Practised the idea that household work can be shared.
Trisha repeatedly said children are too small to help and did not give an unaided correct example.
This idea was still present at the last response.
end.parentNote: Asha practised why sharing household work matters and that anyone in a family can help. Trisha named ways Mummy, Papa, and Dadi care for the family, including getting ready, making tea, cooking, and cleaning. Trisha mixed up the idea by saying children are too small to help; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, invite Trisha to choose one safe task, such as putting books in their bag or placing a water bottle nearby, and talk about how it helps the family.
